workarounds.reason: RoboPlan 0.4 robot-state validity checks still include detached object/object overlap
workarounds.removal_gate: A request-scoped pair policy or filtered robot-state validity API preserves robot/object and attached-object/world checks

workarounds.reason: RoboPlan 0.4 lacks request-scoped collision policy and structured contact diagnostics sufficient for release semantics
workarounds.removal_gate: Per-request policy and exact structured contacts prove start contact, release, and no re-contact without global pair mutation

workarounds.reason: RoboPlan 0.4 exposes no explicit deep-clone contract, so exact-revision planner retention currently invokes Scene copy construction and relies on upstream pointer ownership remaining isolated
workarounds.removal_gate: RP5-1 replaces this with a tested deep clone that survives source destruction and concurrent source mutation under ASan and TSan

workarounds.reason: RoboPlan 0.4 reports colliding names only through debug stdout, so the diagnostic-only comparator captures and parses process output
workarounds.removal_gate: A structured collision-contact result preserves exact body-name mapping without global stdout redirection

workarounds.reason: The pinned RoboPlan/Pinocchio import path can visit a sibling mimic joint before its master when canonical names sort in that order; RMA supplies a private renamed consumer view while public names remain canonical
workarounds.removal_gate: Canonical Lite6 URDF imports directly with identical kinematics, limits, gripper mapping, and public-name behavior across all consumers

workarounds.reason: RoboPlan 0.4 spline fitting can leave endpoint derivatives or positions outside ManyForge's exact start/goal invariants
workarounds.removal_gate: Upstream output satisfies endpoint identity and derivative invariants bit-for-bit across the version-neutral corpus

workarounds.reason: RoboPlan 0.4 TOPPRA accepts scalar scales but does not prove ManyForge per-joint dynamics or TCP-speed caps after spline interpolation
workarounds.removal_gate: A backend-neutral parameterization result proves all requested limits with unchanged fail-closed diagnostics and no performance regression

workarounds.reason: SimpleIk, PathShortcutter, and TOPPRA instances are rebuilt against each retained scene generation to avoid mutable-context aliasing
workarounds.removal_gate: Reusable contexts have explicit generation ownership, reset semantics, source-destruction tests, and lower measured cost without cross-request state leakage

workarounds.reason: RoboPlan 0.4 PathShortcutter documents non-negative seeds as deterministic but its implementation selects random_device for those values; ManyForge deterministically maps the effective uint32 seed into the API's usable negative-int seed domain
workarounds.removal_gate: RoboPlan 0.5 seed behavior is verified against the version-neutral deterministic trajectory corpus and the 0.4-only encoding helper is deleted

workarounds.reason: Pinned RoboPlan 0.4.0 commit includes PR 197 scene mutation and mesh/cylinder fixes
workarounds.removal_gate: Non-LIFO remove, reparent, detach, and mesh/cylinder regression suites remain green
